propositions: The plan-review gate short-circuits bug tickets to bare exempt-PASS with no substantive review (verified: bug 5886 persisted REVIEW_RESULT with runner=exempt, verdict=PASS, llm_calls=0).
FixedBench demonstrates a 35-65% over-action rate with no plan-review criterion asking whether a proposed change is actually needed.
A new pass-1 advisory criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that add mechanisms without establishing motivation or reproduction, accepting justified no-op and well-motivated outcomes.
Bugs must receive a lightweight advisory review tier (DET floor + necessity probe only, never blocking) instead of complete exemption.
The 'necessity' criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and criteria_routing.json with default_posture='advisory' and no bug suppression, unlike existing criteria (A1/E4/G7) that suppress bugs.
Bug-tier logic redirects ticket_type='bug' through DET floor (advisory) and restricts LLM criteria to BUG_TIER_CRITERIA=('necessity',) rather than the full suite.
